name: Jiangsu Leadmicro Nano-Equipment Technology Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Leadmicro Nano-Equipment Technology Ltd engages in manufacturing high-end micro-nano equipment for semiconductor and pan-semiconductor. It focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of advanced micron-level and nanoscale thin-film equipment. The company's business covers integrated circuits, photovoltaics, LEDs, MEMS, and other semiconductor-related fields, as well as new energy and flexible electronics fields.
